description: A chemistry teacher teaches her students two experiments, experiment 1 and experiment 2. In experiment 1, 3 units of the red liquid and 4 units of the blue liquid mix to create 5 units of green gas. In experiment 2, 5 units of the red liquid and 3 units of the blue liquid mix to create 6 units of the green gas. In addition, experiment 1 produces 1 units of smelly gas while experiment 2 produces 2 units of smelly gas.  The lab has available 80 units of red liquid and 70 units of blue liquid. If at most 10 units of smelly gas can be produced, how many experiments of each should be done to maximize the total amount of green gas produced?

RedUsage.definition: Amount of red liquid required for each experiment

BlueUsage.definition: Amount of blue liquid required for each experiment

GreenGasProduction.definition: Amount of green gas produced by each experiment

SmellyGasProduction.definition: Amount of smelly gas produced by each experiment

TotalRed.definition: Total units of red liquid available

TotalBlue.definition: Total units of blue liquid available

MaxSmelly.definition: Maximum units of smelly gas allowed

objective.description: "Maximize the total amount of green gas produced from the experiments"

constraints.description: The total red liquid used by both experiments should not exceed 80 units
The total blue liquid used by both experiments should not exceed 70 units
The total smelly gas produced by both experiments should not exceed 10 units
constraints.code:
model.addConstr(
    sum(SmellyGasProduction[i] * NumRuns[i] for i in range(NumExperiments)) 
    <= MaxSmelly
)

constraints.description: The number of times each experiment is conducted must be non-negative

NumRuns.definition: Number of times each experiment is performed
